about.description: Bloom is a Cayman Foundation-operated tokenized US Treasury platform issuing "TBY" (Term Bound Yield) tokens, which represent fixed-maturity exposure to short-duration US Treasury bills. Each TBY series targets a specific 6-month maturity and matures back into USDC at par plus accrued yield. The protocol uses a regulated US broker-dealer for the underlying T-bill execution. Bloom is sister-protocol to Blueberry Protocol (a DeFi lending platform) and aims to bring institutional-grade T-bill yield to on-chain market makers, treasuries, and DeFi protocols seeking risk-free returns.
about.registryInfo: Bloom is operated by the Blueberry Foundation, a Cayman Islands not-for-profit foundation company. The platform tokenizes US Treasury-backed bills via a US registered broker-dealer affiliate (TBY - "Term Bound Yield" tokens). Founders: Kris Rojek and the Blueberry team (previously Blueberry Protocol). Backed by Hack VC, Alliance, Tribe Capital, and others.

fees.revenueNotes: Bloom's TBY tokens accrue yield against an underlying T-bill basket. The 20 bps spread is an estimate based on Term Bound Yield maturity structure and comparable platforms (e.g., Mountain). Bloom does not publish the exact spread.
